| # Secure Logging {#secure-logging-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}        |                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This section describes the secure logging feature implemented in the RC40 to detect and record important security-related and diagnostic events that occur during the ECU runtime.

 

+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Attention](attention.png){style="margin:0;width:2.1667in;height:0.7083in;border:none"} | •We cannot perform logging on the RC over an extended period of time, and do not have a time available on the device for reliable time stamps. |
|                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                |
|                                                                                          | •The customer is advised to retrieve logged events periodically, and at least before flashing, to build a log on system level.                 |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
